narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to northern Ocean County during the late afternoon and early evening of August 5. Rainfall totals were as high as 3.0 to 4.5 inches.
ev: Numerous vehicles were stranded and minor basement flooding was reported in some homes. US Route 9 was closed in both directions at James Street.
A vehicle became trapped in flood waters in Jackson Township, requiring a water rescue.
lsr: LAW ENFORCEMENT IN LAKEWOOD TOWNSHIP REPORTED VEHICLES STRANDED AND HOUSES FLOODING AROUND TOWN. NUMEROUS CALLS INTO THE OFFICE.
VIDEO ON SOCIAL MEDIA OF VEHICLES STRANDED AT COUNTY LINE ROAD AND PINE PARK. TIME GIVEN IN REPORT.
PLUMSTED TWP 911 CALL CENTER REPORTS A WATER RESCUE OCCURRED IN JACKSON. NO REPORTED INJURIES. TIME ESTIMATED VIA RADAR.
ROUTE 9 CLOSED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS AT JAMES STREET AND PINES STREET DUE TO HIGH WATER.
